objective: Delete the still-open monotonicity premise in Brain-first differential dominance for the three binary matched-success predicates by freezing a shared exact reducer before any new terminal case exposure.

reducer.conservative_semantics: R equals the observed success fraction on the complete declared acceptance case universe and therefore never exceeds that finite-scope empirical success fraction.

theorem.statement: For N>0 and 0<=k0<=k1<=N, k1/N >= k0/N. Therefore exact finite-scope success fraction is monotone under success-set inclusion.
